title: Temporary Extension of Fentanyl-Related Substances Scheduling Act
latestAction: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary:
Temporary Extension of Fentanyl-Related Substances Scheduling Act

This bill extends until September 30, 2025, the temporary scheduling order issued by the Drug Enforcement Administration to place fentanyl-related substances in schedule I of the Controlled Substances Act. The temporary order expires on March 31, 2025.

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
